ambiguities_and_exclusions.detail: Author references were used to create scripted offline controls; future live performance on these known cases is source-relative DEV performance, not independent unseen semantic gold.
The paired stage3 recipes ask different tasks. Shared input is not interchangeable completion-versus-pattern correctness.

The frozen authored target selects one omitted relation and one qualified recurrence/negative control. Novel hypotheses or other templates are not silently relabeled correct gold or independent discoveries; report separately with source witnesses.
left-source/right-source are caller-declared fixture labels. Actual independent source origins are unverified; no independence/generalization metric is registered.
The frozen prompt allows links=[]. No link count, mandatory topology depth or particular relation predicate is a semantic-adequacy gold requirement.
Unknown validation does not establish failure or permission. No outside policy is added to resolve that source ambiguity.
Stage3 direction/shared_source/scope/unicode references and unselected pinned reply cases are outside the frozen 24-request population. Stage5, holdout and private material are excluded.

common_case_criteria.requirement: Preserve the supplied speaker, branch/source scope, polarity, conditional scope, chronology and asserted/required versus hypothetical/proposed role; never turn the prior graph into automatic world truth.
source_evidence: stage4 reply_prompt and input entity attrs

common_case_criteria.requirement: A source-backed statement must be entailed by its exact source span with those qualifiers. Unwitnessed inferences, hypotheses or assistant recommendations must be explicit as such and must not replace or impersonate the source/user commitment.
No unsupported relation, inverse implication, current decision, validation result, independent-source claim or general law may be presented as an observed/source-authorized fact.
A later correction can supersede an earlier source commitment without deleting its historical existence or attributing the change to another speaker.

evaluation_protocol.annotation_trace: For each dimension retain label pass/fail/unavailable, criterion IDs, exact response span or proposal pointer, and input source-point IDs/spans. Reviewers map sources; do not impose a citation field absent from the frozen format. Keep disagreements/ambiguities unresolved until separately reported.

dimensions_separate.compiler_validity: Existing pinned schema/DTO/topology/span/diff and transformation-loss checks. A valid compilation may still be semantically wrong or ungrounded.
dimensions_separate.semantic_adequacy: All applicable required content obligations satisfied and no contradictory/unsupported source assertion; representation-independent meaning, not record shape alone.
dimensions_separate.source_grounding: Each asserted source-relative fact or verified occurrence is warranted by exact supplied evidence with attribution and qualifiers; hypotheses/proposals remain explicitly separate.
dimensions_separate.transport_and_billing: Not semantic correctness; retained separately and never substituted for an adequacy/grounding label.

evaluation_protocol.extras_rule: Optional links, hypotheses, recommendations, wording, node granularity and confidence values are not newly required. If emitted they must preserve the source/proposal distinction and may not assert unsupported source truth. No numeric confidence threshold, external domain rule or forced semantic link is introduced.
evaluation_protocol.missingness_rule: Every planned request remains in adequacy and grounding denominators. Failed, missing, unattempted, unreadable or unresolved responses have zero successful outcomes and an explicit unavailable reason; they are never dropped or counted correct. Report attempted/evaluable/compiled counts separately. Before future execution, all measured values remain uncomputed/null.
evaluation_protocol.pairing_rule: Stage4 content criteria are identical for graph and textJSON arms. Stage3 shares the same case integrity/grounding facts across tracks, but completion and pattern discovery have different frozen task targets; their track-specific success rates are not a direct same-task winner comparison.
evaluation_protocol.raw_preservation: Evaluate the bound original first capture, never a repaired JSON retry or rewritten answer. Mechanical invalidity remains recorded even if public content is unambiguously interpretable for independent semantic review. Missing, unreadable or ambiguously rendered public content is semantic_unavailable, not correct.
evaluation_protocol.reporting_rule: Report pass_count/planned_count and evaluable/planned coverage for each dimension and arm. Optional pass/evaluable is labeled conditional and accompanies the full planned denominator. All-unavailable semantic content has no measured model-quality claim. Grounding of an explicitly correct empty negative-control result can pass the no-unsupported-assertion check; its emitted-assertion/link cohort is zero, not fabricated evidence.

semantic_equivalence_policy.added_claim_identifiers: A valid noncolliding added claim identifier may differ from the authored target ID. Existing input entity/source identities and their meaning are still preserved.
semantic_equivalence_policy.authored_reference_record_role: Audit target and evidence anchor, not a required literal model-output template. Existing literal reference_agreement remains a separately named record/mechanism metric.
semantic_equivalence_policy.historical_metadata: Do not impose authored confidence numbers, archive/scripted origin metadata or particular prose/node granularity as semantic gold.
semantic_equivalence_policy.wording: Faithful paraphrase may differ from authored wording or predicate spelling when relation meaning, direction, qualifiers, epistemic mode and exact supporting source are unchanged. No stronger causal claim or new implication is licensed.

evaluation_protocol.unit: One immutable first-response opportunity per planned request. The exact case criteria do not vary by requested/observed model, provider, prompt arm or transport outcome.
